<p> While attempting to geocode your batch input, the Census Geocoder encountered an error from which it cannot recover. This may be caused by the fact that the Census Geocoder is experiencing a period of high usage, is unable to connect to a service it is dependent on, or the batch file contains a formatting error or  invalid data type. Please verify your batch file and resubmit your batch query again later.<p>More information and documentation (available in HTML and PDF formats) about the Census Geocoder and how to use it can be found here: <a href='https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/'>https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/</a></p>
